'''Dock 52''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was the private mooring dock for the [[Orange Lady Tavern]]. [[Thaddeus Ross]] and [[Trep Winterrs]] berthed the ''[[Kierra]]'' in Dock 52 after a botched mission to protect an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]].<ref name="LAD" />
